scope: Explicit tool-reported error codes on Boolean isError=true MCP results, not a task success score
supportedRepresentations: Known CLI bridge structuredContent.response plus mirrored JSON TextContent
JSON TextContent with success=false, nonempty string error, and technical code label
unclassified: Absent, unsupported, conflicting, unsafe or redacted labels
Categories omitted by the per-tool cap
compatibility: Old reports without reportedErrorCodes are unmeasured, never assumed to have zero unclassified errors

validation.configuration: Debug module tests, compiled CLI, and offscreen actual SwiftUI panel; no full App or Release rebuild

realReplay.boundary: Bounded recent log tails, not complete sessions or a quality ranking. App-specific code observations are not automatic diagnoses, billable usage, or retry instructions.

boundaries: Error codes are application-specific and optional; uncoded errors remain explicit errors
Never classifies prose, arguments, nested business data or native media payloads
Host invocation failures without MCP results remain separate
No automatic retry, health score, tool disabling, install or publication
Source-only change; no existing packaged or installed build acceptance updated
